Visit note | 2025-06-28 03:00 PM | Dr. Rafiqul Islam, Cardiology | Patient: Nazma Islam, 75, female. Mrs. Islam comes in describing discomfort in her jaw and left arm on effort with no chest pain, noting that she feels chest tightness when walking fast or climbing and a heavy feeling in the chest that eases with rest within minutes. She mentions that this started while carrying shopping bags uphill in Motijheel. She works as a homemaker and lives with her family. She denies any prior cardiac history, shortness of breath at rest, or palpitations. On examination: BP 140/84 mmHg, pulse 83 bpm, weight 93 kg. Heart sounds are normal and lungs are clear. Assessment: Stable angina. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid heavy exertion until review, walk 20 minutes daily on flat ground, and stop smoking. Follow-up in 2 weeks with an ECG and fasting lipid profile.

Visit note | 2025-06-28 03:00 PM | Dr. Kamrul Hasan, Pulmonology | Patient: Shahana Hasan, 56, female. Mrs. Hasan attends for a review regarding her chronic respiratory symptoms, reporting coughing at night, a tight chest in dust or cold air, and wheezing. She explains that these issues have become worse since construction dust started near her home in Khilgaon. She works as a journalist and notes she has been exposed to various environmental triggers. She reports no fever or recent weight loss. On examination: SpO2 92%, BP 117/86 mmHg, pulse 80 bpm, weight 63 kg. Chest examination reveals bilateral wheezes. Assessment: Bronchial asthma. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid dust and smoke, keep the bedroom well aired, and learn the correct inhaler technique. Follow-up in 1 month to check inhaler technique.

Visit note | 2025-06-28 03:00 PM | Dr. Moinul Haque, Neurology | Patient: Arifa Howlader, 67, female.
